sections.title: Missouri property tax: state rules

rows.label: Levied by
rows.value: Counties and other political subdivisions (cities, towns, villages, townships, school, road and other districts); the State may levy a small tax

source.title: Missouri Secretary of State: Constitution of the State of Missouri (PDF), Article X

rows.label: State oversight
rows.value: State Tax Commission of Missouri (constitutional equalization commission)
rows.note: Equalizes assessments between counties and hears assessment appeals. Its website (stc.mo.gov) refused automated access, so the constitution is cited.

source.title: Missouri Secretary of State: Constitution of the State of Missouri (PDF), Article X, Section 14

rows.label: Maximum local tax rates
rows.value: Municipalities $1.00 per $100 assessed value; counties 35 or 50 cents per $100 (plus separate limits for school districts and road levies)
rows.note: Constitutional caps, which voters can raise for limited periods.

source.title: Missouri Secretary of State: Constitution of the State of Missouri (PDF), Article X, Section 11(b)

rows.label: State property tax limit
rows.value: State tax on real and tangible personal property capped at 10 cents per $100 of assessed value
rows.note: Excludes any tax needed to pay state bonded debt.

sections.title: Missouri real estate transfer tax

rows.label: Real estate transfer tax
rows.value: None: the Missouri Constitution bars the State, counties and other local governments from imposing any new tax on the sale or transfer of real estate
